title: A must do in Barcelona
text: Amazing tour with Germans who brought the Gothic Quarter to life with deep knowledge of history, architecture and fun facts. She went above and beyond calling an olive oil shop to help select some oil to bring home. The drinks and tapas at the end were a perfect finish!
author: Cheryl_E

title: Great tour!
text: Our guide Ariana was the best! So lovely to spend the time with and so knowledgeable about her city! We adored her!!
author: Laura_B

title: Very complete tour and professional guide
text:
We did the tour of stories and legends of the Gothic quarter.

I’ve been living in Barcelona for 6 years, and walking again through streets that I pass almost daily accompanied by Aaron was special. He's an honest guide who loves his work. His knowledge and passion for history is undeniable.

I recommend it to everyone who wants to know how Barcelona became what it is, and uncover stories that cannot be read just by looking at its streets and walls. 

You will leave this tour with another perspective of the city, and in general with knowledge that will make you better understand our history an
author: _miguel_meneo

title: Very interesting and enjoyable
text: We have done the tour with Aaron and, although we are from Barcelona, he has explained many interesting stories that we did not know. He has answered all the questions and we have had a super nice time! I recommend it for whoever is a lover of the city and this magical neighborhood.

title: This was our first trip to Barcelona...
text:
This was our first trip to Barcelona were a family of four with two adults, in our 40s, and two teenagers 16 and 14. We took the English tour on 27 July 2017. Our guide, Núria, was friendly, knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and full of information, stories, and legends of the Gothic Quarter! Our tour lasted a bit over two and a half hours, and provided us with lots of interesting information and helped us better appreciate Barcelona, its history, and its culture. We highly recommend this tour! It was lots of fun, and very interesting too!
